d: Explore the theme of society and myths that engulf memories of the past. These myths often become woven into the fabric of our society and can pass through generations.
Examine how conflict has reshaped nations and devastated generations. Wars dominate history but the reasons for them starting are constantly disputed.
The Rookie Miner's search for a mythical gold reef backfires badly, but in Ballarat, prospector Ian and his apprentice April finish their season with a $19,000 gold bonanza.
Gold mining expert Ian Holland takes on 25-year-old rookie prospector April as an apprentice, while rookie miner Dennis tries to get started with the gold processing plant.
Businessman and rookie miner Dennis gambles $500,000 on a 62-acre gold mine, while Leigh asks two British backpackers for a lesson in metal detecting.
The Clermont diggers face pressure to repay $15,000 worth of gold, or risk losing their mine. Meanwhile, the Mineshaft Hunters enter an abandoned gold mine.
Adrenaline-fuelled prospecting and mining teams search for gold in some of the most remote and inhospitable areas of Australia.
A catastrophic breakdown threatens to end the Clermont Diggers' mining season, while the rookie miners' gamble to relocate their old plant ends in disaster.
Rookie miner Dennis enjoys a personal-best nugget find in a bumper day, while the Mineshaft Hunters' quest for gold is cut short when a team member takes a life threatening fall.
As the season comes to a close, the Clermont Diggers unearth a monster nugget. Meanwhile, the Mineshaft Hunters face a life-or-death emergency.
The Clermont Diggers come up with a new plan to boost their daily gold output, but they have to contend with the radical strategy's flaws.
The hunt begins not with diamonds and gold, but with skin and bone, unearthed in the dangerous wilds of Russia's arctic Yamal Peninsula. But was this ice-age discovery doomed?

The hunt starts in Turin with the controversial Shroud, moves to Ice Age Spain and a fraud-tainted discovery, then to Manchester where a statue seems to move and ends with the cursed blue diamond tied to misery and bloodshed.
The hunt begins in Russia with a room that was described as the eighth Wonder of the World. But since its mysterious disappearance during WW2, it has left a trail of conspiracy and bloodshed.
The hunt begins in the historical Kingdom of Benin, Africa. Destroyed in 1897, with its city burned to the ground and precious artefacts looted, did this bloody and violent end lead to a curse?
York: Dan explores the history of York's castle, from the Viking Jorvik and the Normans, to the dark days of the anti-Jewish pogrom and the imprisonment of the Knights Templar.
Leeds: Dan Jones explores the 900-year history of the beautiful Leeds Castle in Kent, from its origins as a royal Saxon family's manor to a 20th-century retreat for the rich.
Join Historian Dan Jones as he travels back in time to explore Carrickfergus Castle.
